authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat even-side faces lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 84-56 (even side, Bilderdijkstraat to Da Costakade), 2024-11-29 low-sun strip. 76-84 is a 1979 infill block (kinker-1985-infill, one front with its own 13-axis grid); 56-74 are the 1893 Neo-Renaissance speklagen row (kinker-1886-neo-renaissance, 2 axes per module, step/pointed gables and two gabled dormers). Shops read on the pand-reference zoom crops (same day). Re-stripped on 2023-01-10 (overcast, camera height 2.4 m; the 2024-11-29 strip was blown out over the gables and cast cyan, which drew the fronts olive); measured bricks re-read on brick pixels of that strip (Oud-West kit #98). Bricks then fitted halfway between the strip median and the exact inverse of the city tint (scripts/block-face/fit-wall-palette.ts), stripOverDrawn 0.705 -> 0.925. Crowns re-read on the 2023-01-10 strip: brick wall dormers on 62 and 60 (crown wall-dormer, dormerBody brick), a white stone dormer on 66 (crown stone-dormer).
